chapter: Los Angeles with Mutt Carey and the taxi dances
title: Mutt, Ory and Joe Oliver
summary: Joe says Ory told him he fired Oliver and replaced him with Mutt, and that Joe left Los Angeles on an ocean liner before Ory returned.

story.theme_name: Chicago: the jazz migration and its clubs
story.community_name: Going north: working the Chicago jazz scene

blocks.x: Like I say, I want to get on to Ory on the next tape. But get me up to this Liberty Band of Papa Mutt's. Had Mutt been playing with Ory when Ory was out here?

Oh, yeah. Papa Mutt and Ory had worked off and on all their life, I guess. Ory said when he fired Joe Oliver... Oliver used to play with Ory's band, and Ory said he fired him and Papa Mutt took his place.
That's what Ory said, he fired him?
I don't know whether we'll find that out for sure, but probably Joe Oliver would say the opposite.
Well, he sure said it. But Mutt... When Ory come back here from Chicago... See, I had left in the meantime on an ocean liner.
How long a trip was that?
